renderings.value: I also really had the feeling of having had a relaxed day with my family for the first time in a long while.
This is the first time in a while that someone we had such high hopes for came to our department.
All I can think about is next month's vacation. I haven't been on one in so long.
Hearing this song after so long really brings back the old times.
Yesterday was the first time in a long time that I really worked out, so all the muscles in my body ached when I woke up this morning.
It's been a long time since I've heard the word "baby bottle".
Yesterday I had some free time for the first time in a long time, so I went swimming.
Tom went outside for the first time in a long time.
It's been a while since I've had pasta.
